sentences.text: Appearance:

Shri Manish Datt, Senior Counsel with Shri Vijay Dutt  learned counsel for the petitioner .
 Shri Samar Ghuraiya Dy Ga appearing on behalf of Advo  Shri Siddharth Sharma, learned counsel for the respon  ORDER
The applicant has filed this First bail application under Section 482 of BNSS/438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.153/2025 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Guna (M.P.) in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468 471, 120B of IPC.

As per prosecution story, the complainant has filed a complaint alleging therein that the applicant along with the co-accused persons prepared a forged mutation tax receipt and on its basis had gone one relinquishment deed dated 25.8.2022 executed in favour of his mother in which the area mentioned was 4110 Sq. Ft. which is the total area and not NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:16951 2 MCRC-27731-2025 his 1/3rd share in connivance with the Sub Registrar Office, Guna and the witnesses in place of his share of 2055 square feet.

In this way, applicant got the title relinquishment deed of 1/2 part executed in favour of his mother Sushila Jain with the aim of usurping his and other building owners' property from his brother Jambu's share.
On the basis of aforesaid, the present case was registered against him.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that no offence has been committed by the applicant a predominantly civil matter has been given criminal flavor, wherein all the parties are close family members & various civil suits are pending between the rival parties.

It is further submitted that the applicant is 44 years of age and is doctor by profession and permanent resident of District Guna and there is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
applicant undertakes to cooperate in investigation/trial and would not be a source of embarrassment and harassment in any manner to the complainant party side.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and condition as imposed by this Court.
Under these grounds, learned counsel prayed for anticipatory bail.

Learned counsel further submitted that the co-accused Sushila Jain, mother of the applicant had been extended the benefit of anticipatory bail by the learned Trial Court, therefore, similar benefit be granted to the applicant.

Learned counsel for the respondent/State and the counsel for the complainant has vehemently opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16951 3 MCRC-27731-2025 the application.

They further submitted that on the basis of forged documents,
the relinquishment deed of entire house was executed by the applicant in favour of his mother, while he was having only 1/3rd share and thereafter mortgaged the entire house with bank, they had cheated the complainant, therefore, offences as mentioned above had rightly been registered against the applicant and his mother.
Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

entities.text: Amit Kumar Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE (aspr)
